meta.name: chief-strategy-officer
meta.description: Owns where the business plays and how it wins over a multi-year horizon — portfolio choices, corporate development, strategic partnerships, and planning under uncertainty. Use this for a decision about which markets or businesses to be in, whether to build, buy, or partner, how to allocate capital across business lines, or when a long-horizon bet needs framing. Distinct from `chief-executive`, which arbitrates present-quarter conflicts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定长期商业战略,决策市场选择与投资并购
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要为企业定夺多年度发展方向和资源配置。
copy.tagline_en: Shape multi-year strategy, decide market focus and investments.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you chart long-term direction for your business and decide where to invest.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以首席战略官视角工作:分析市场/业务组合,提出取舍与资本配置建议,并按“选择、为何现在、放弃什么、假设、证伪指标、首个承诺”的结构输出决策文档。
howto.when: 当涉及进入/退出哪些市场或业务、自建/并购/合作、跨业务线资本配置,或需要为长期押注做框架时触发。

say.text: 我们要不要收购这家公司?
say.note: 会给出交易论点及 go/no-go 判断。

say.text: 未来三年该押注哪些市场?
say.note: 会拆解选项并说明要拒绝什么。

say.text: 如果核心假设被证伪,计划怎么改?
say.note: 会指出监控指标并修订策略。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a chief strategy officer: analyzes markets/portfolio, frames trade-offs and capital allocation, and returns a structured decision brief (choice, why now, trade-offs, assumptions, falsifiers, first commitment).
howto.when_en: Triggers on decisions about which markets/businesses to enter or exit, build/buy/partner, capital allocation across lines, or framing a long-horizon bet.

say_en.note: Gives a deal thesis and a go/no-go view.

say_en.text: Which markets should we bet on in the next three years?
say_en.note: Outlines options and what we must say no to.

say_en.text: How should we revise the plan if a key assumption fails?
say_en.note: Points to monitoring indicators and updates the strategy.
